In summary, our research is concerned with
the first characterization of the expression and subcellular localization of PKCι in rat and human hepatocyte.
the expression and localization of aPKCs in hepatocytes.
the expression and localization of the atypical PKC-isoforms, PKCζ and the newly cloned PKCι in hepatocytes.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
PKCι is expressed and localized in liver parenchyme, in particular in hepatocytes, and may play a role in bile salt export.
aPKCs are expressed in hepatocytes at the canalicular and sinusoidal membrane, and in the cytoplasm.
PKCι is expressed in hepatocytes and is localized to the canalicular membrane.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the aPKC isoforms, PKCζ and, in particular, PKCι, are expressed in liver parenchyme cells and are localized at the canalicular membranes.
PKCiota and PKCzeta are expressed in liver parenchmal cells and are localized at the sinusoidal and canalicular membranes.
the expression of aPKC isoforms PKCι and PKCζ is restricted to liver parenchyma cells.
The main takeaway from our work is that
PKCι and PKCζ are expressed in hepatocytes and localized to the canalicular membrane.
PKCι is a major isoform of atypical PKCs in hepatocytes and that it co-localizes with PKCζ at the canalicular membranes.
PKCι and PKCζ are both highly expressed and co-localize with ABC transporters at the canalicular membranes of hepatocytes.
